KayKit Adventurers Character Pack 1.0, by Kay Lousberg.
https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0
https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers

Imported files include Knight.fbx, RogueHooded.fbx, Mage.fbx and their texture atlases.
The FBX files were downloaded from the author's public GitHub repository.
The license notice from the pack is included in LICENSE.txt (CC0).

The project prefabs select one sword per fighter and one staff for the mage.
The project uses the embedded clips.
